defects.description: The requirements never specify a refund policy for cancellation at all -- both implementations invented one independently.
The requirements never specify a cancellation cutoff window -- the API path's 24-hour cutoff has no basis in the spec.

Because neither was specified, the two entry points (API vs admin panel) silently diverged: the API path only refunds outside 24 hours, the admin path always refunds -- the same underlying action produces different financial outcomes depending on which UI performed it.
